reason: Provides a DSH settings interface for searching the GitHub plugin library and can install selected npm or GitHub plugins, including through model-callable tools; human review is warranted because it installs external code and modifies profile configuration.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置页搜索 GitHub 官方插件库、浏览插件详情，并通过 npm 或 GitHub 源安装选定插件。
summaries.en: Searches and browses the official GitHub plugin library in DSH settings and installs selected plugins from npm or GitHub sources.

capabilities: Queries GitHub Search API and falls back to scraping the GitHub dsh-plugin topic page
Displays searchable and paginated plugin listings in a DSH settings tab
Installs plugins from npm or GitHub sources by invoking pnpm
Modifies DSH profile plugin configuration for installed plugins
Registers model-callable tools for searching, installing, and listing installed plugins
